isitan-idk.name: IDK circle cutting machines — hydraulic, motorized and manual circle shears
isitan-idk.summary: Circle cutting shears cut round blanks — and on the IDK-5, 3.5 and 2 also inside diameters (rings) — from sheet clamped at its centre and rotated between two circular blades. The IDK-5 is the production machine: hydraulic centre clamp, motorized cutting-diameter adjustment, discs up to 78.7″ in 3/16″ steel and an optional flanging attachment that turns the edge of the disc up to 3/8″ for tank heads. The IDK-3.5 adds a pneumatic clamp to a 47″ machine, the IDK-2 and IDK-1.8 are rigid cast-frame motorized cutters for 14 ga, and the IDK-1 is the hand-operated bench model.
features: IDK-5: welded steel frame, hydraulic centre clamp, motorized cutting-diameter adjustment, inside-diameter cutting, mobile control panel
IDK-3.5: pneumatic centre clamp (116 psi air supply), motorized diameter adjustment, inside-diameter cutting
IDK-2: rigid cast frame, blades in bearings, foot pedal, inside-diameter cutting
IDK-1.8: rigid cast frame, blades in bronze bushings, foot pedal
Special-steel (1.2379) blades; shafts on conical bearings for long blade life; gearbox motor with brake
optional: IDK-5: flanging attachment for edge flanging up to 3/8″; digital readout
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor

caps.IDK-5: cuts discs to Ø78.7″ (2000 mm) in 3/16″ (5 mm) · hydraulic clamp
caps.IDK-3.5: cuts discs to Ø47.2″ (1200 mm) in 10 ga · pneumatic clamp
caps.IDK-2: cuts discs to Ø39.4″ (1000 mm) in 14 ga · heavy-duty cast frame
caps.IDK-1.8: cuts discs to Ø39.4″ (1000 mm) in 14 ga · foot pedal
caps.IDK-1: cuts discs to Ø39.4″ (1000 mm) in 20 ga · manual

specs.note: Cutting capacities are for mild steel; thin sheet is given in gauge with the manufacturer's nominal metric value in brackets. Dimensions are overall L × W × H.

isitan-idk.headline: Discs Ø4.3″ – 78.7″ (110–2000 mm) · sheet to 3/16″ (5 mm) · inside-diameter cutting

isitan-ls-13p.name: LS-13P pneumatic heavy-duty lock seaming machine
isitan-ls-13p.summary: A motorized lock seamer that closes the longitudinal lock seam of round ducts and pipes: a gearbox-driven pinching system with pneumatic pressing, hardened seaming rolls on a ball-bearing slide, and pinching and rotation controlled from the foot pedal. Seams up to 51″ long in 18 ga sheet on pipes of 3.9″ to 5.1″ diameter — the companion to the slip roll and the bead roller in the HVAC shop.
features: Gearbox-driven pinching system; pneumatic pressing for easy operation
Pinching and rotation controlled by the standard foot pedal
Hardened seaming rolls; sliding system on ball bearings
Pneumatic system protected by air filter
optional: Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor
